{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "purpleKarrot",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested dropping user_data in favor of a plain function pointer"
    },
    {
      "login": "ryanofsky",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to global logging connection restricting future API, and noted callback self-destruction hang in lock-free logging"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; raised concern about test state leakage and asked about raw pointer"
    },
    {
      "login": "w0xlt",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Approach ACK; noted test callback leakage and suggested RAII wrapper"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:4023693537",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Drop local user_data in favor of a simple function pointer",
      "quote": "Since the log function is global, there is no need for local user data. It can be a simple function pointer, even in the C++ wrapper.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that user_data avoids forcing users to use globals for state",
      "author_replies": ["c:4024237014"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:4024237014",
      "status_by_quote": "Forcing the user to use globals if they need state seems unnecessary, when using `user_data` is I think a well-establish"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4024456177",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Prematurely restricts the kernel logging API in a way difficult to reverse without notable simplification",
      "quote": "I think it would be a mistake to limit functionality of the logging/debuging/tracing API prematurely, in a way that seems difficult to reverse and does not seem to provide a noticeable simplification",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "ryanofsky pushed back that not attaching connections to contexts will force client restructuring once contextual logging is added",
      "author_replies": ["c:4635220722", "c:6002226366"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5775672229",
      "status_by_quote": "Where I'm still stuck is not requiring clients to attach a connection to what it should receive entries from."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3395620071",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Does the pointer have to be a raw pointer?",
      "quote": "Does this have to be a raw pointer?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that a raw pointer avoids running consumer code from static destructors during process teardown",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4023175438"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4023175438",
      "status_by_quote": "I think so, to avoid running consumer code from static destructors."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3395661504",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Global logging callback leaks state across unit tests if not reset",
      "quote": "Even though this function is scoped to this test, it now enables logging for all the the other unit tests too. Maybe add another call to set the callback to null at the end of the test?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed an RAII Logger class wrapper preventing state leakage across tests",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4036445255"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4036445255",
      "status_by_quote": "The `Logger` class should offer all required functionality, in a way that is much harder to abuse. Thank you both for yo"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3395677816",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Rename to logging_reset_callback and remove the argument",
      "quote": "How about calling this `logging_reset_callback` and removing the argument?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed in concept but noted it was rendered obsolete by the new Logger wrapper design",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4036448224"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4036448224",
      "status_by_quote": "I agree, but this is no longer relevant in the latest version as per https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34775#discu"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3591591675",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Tests installing global callback leak state unless explicitly cleared",
      "quote": "any test that installs the global logging callback now needs to clear it before returning to prevent state leakage into later tests.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted RAII wrapper approach to prevent test state leakage",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4036445255"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4036445255",
      "status_by_quote": "The `Logger` class should offer all required functionality, in a way that is much harder to abuse."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3591661659",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Retain RAII in the C++ wrapper while exposing a single global logging callback",
      "quote": "I think the C++ wrapper could retain RAII while still exposing a single global logging callback.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented an RAII Logger class in the C++ wrapper",
      "author_replies": ["c:5713771648", "rc:4036445255"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5713771648",
      "status_by_quote": "address @w0xlt's suggestion to have an RAII `Logger` in the C++ wrapper instead of free functions"
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5775672229",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Split the lock-free callback deadlock fix into #36768 and rebase this PR on it",
      "quote": "The fix doesn't depend on having a single connection, so I'm hoping it can go in separately and this PR can rebase on it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4473236493",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A callback destroying its own connection hangs because destroy waits for running invocations",
      "quote": "A callback that destroys its own connection now hangs, because destroy waits for running invocations, including the one it's called from.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4022995511",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Not having separate connections seems simpler, clients can multiplex themselves, and it is pragmatic",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4792069971",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Updated ryanofsky's review comments following edits pointing to #36768 instead of #36766. The objection on callback self-destruction hang and suggestion to split the deadlock fix remain open.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "respond to ryanofsky's objection about callback self-destruction hang and suggestion to split the fix into #36768",
      "id": "rc:4473236493"
    }
  ]
}
